actual_tool_parameters.prompt:
Create one complete full-color Japanese anime character illustration of Bunny holding her two fictional fantasy daggers, on a spacious white landscape page. Clean expressive hand-drawn linework and crisp cel-color shapes, matching the accepted character artwork. Calm focused character pose, no opponent or injury.

REFERENCE ROLES:
1. Current accepted COLOR Bunny: exact identity, face, silver-white hair, blue eyes, ears, forehead goggles, outfit colors and details, the real stylized OG sleeve emblem, glove and wrist equipment. Do NOT copy this standing pose.
2. V10 line drawing: use its whole-body pose and roomy page layout. Keep the high right arm / low left arm, shoulder-hip direction, feet, body proportions and scale on the page. This drawing is NOT an identity/color authority or weapon design authority.
3. Accepted dagger master: use these exact two different fictional weapons, including their blade silhouettes, guards, grips and pommels. Right hand = dark angular broad dagger; left hand = long ivory swept dagger. Retain the large fantasy-blade appearance and normal one-hand grips. Their projected lengths may differ with angle; do not force a flat diagram ratio into this pose.

Make the two specific corrections to reference 2 while redrawing the whole artwork:
- Ivory blade: restore reference 3's flowing forward-swept outer contour. Remove the extra projecting shoulder/step near the tip that the line drawing invented. Preserve the separate curved guard and ivory teardrop pommel.
- Character's LEFT sleeve pocket: faithfully redraw the actual white stylized OG insignia from reference 1, including its logo shapes; not ordinary typeset CG letters.

Preserve correct hand contact: fingers and opposing thumbs enclose the grips, guards outside fists, no skin touching blade edges. RIGHT hand is entirely black full-finger glove INCLUDING thumb, with its solid RED wrist cuff. LEFT hand is black fingerless glove with exposed fingertips and an ORANGE rectangular screen wrist terminal. Preserve both different dagger hilts and only the two held daggers.

Use the accepted silver-white layered hair and blue eyes, calm focused closed-mouth face, only forehead goggles. Orange high-low jacket with dark trim/red inner lapels, white top and white hem, exposed waist, red shorts, one black pants belt, RIGHT thigh upper terminal and lower pouch on two straps, LEFT long orange stocking and RIGHT short white sock, and original red/black/white shoes. Keep body/limb lengths and volume. No shoulder harness, upper straps, chains, sheaths, side-waist clips or extra handles; rear-waist attachments can remain hidden by the body.

Keep the entire figure, boots and both knife tips within generous white margins. Matte cel skin/clothes with deliberate hard shadows; no plastic shine, random white speckles, cloudy patches, oil-painted texture or soft airbrush modeling. Weapon facet highlights follow the accepted master. No text, diagram labels or extra panels.
